title: DuraTrack
description: Durability checker mod with color-coded alerts. Works with all tools. For NeoForge 1.21.1.
body:
# DuraTrack

**DuraTrack** is a lightweight and handy client-side mod that helps you keep track of your tool durability in Minecraft. No more unexpected tool breaks while you're mining or fighting!

## 🔧 Features

- **Real-time durability monitoring** – The mod constantly checks the durability of the item in your hand
- **Multiple alert thresholds** – Get notified when your tool reaches 50%, 25%, 15%, and 5% durability remaining
- **Durability numbers change color too** – The remaining durability number is colored based on the current percentage
- **Multi-language support** – Works in Russian and English (automatically detects your game language)
- **Compatible with all damageable items** – Works with pickaxes, axes, shovels, swords, hoes, bows, crossbows, fishing rods, shears, and more
